claim: Pad TR1: FDB TRANS1,$6A+7,$51-1,CURTR1 → TPOSX $6A+7=113, TPOSY $51-1=80 (top tier) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5587).
Pad TR2: FDB TRANS2,$E0+7,$81-1,CURTR2 → TPOSX $E0+7=231, TPOSY $81-1=128 (middle tier) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5588).
Pad TR3: FDB TRANS3,$10+7,$8A-1,CURTR3 → TPOSX $10+7=23, TPOSY $8A-1=137 (middle tier) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5589).
Pad TR4: FDB TRANS4,$78+7,$D3-1,CURTR4 → TPOSX $78+7=127, TPOSY $D3-1=210 (bottom tier) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5590).
SELARE reads the object Y (PPOSY+1,X) to classify it into a screen third (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6413).
SELARE bottom-third boundary is the OPERAND #$A3+6 = $A9; the "$8A+6" second column is a dead comment (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6414).
SELARE: BLO 1$ — Y below $A9 keeps checking (not the bottom third) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6415).
SELARE: else INC AREA3 marks the bottom third occupied (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6416).
SELARE middle-third boundary is #$51: Y below $51 is the top third, else middle (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6419).
SELARE: BLO 2$ — Y below $51 branches to the top third (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6420).
SELARE: else INC AREA2 marks the middle third occupied (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6421).
SELARE: INC AREA1 marks the top third occupied — the remaining case (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6424).

source.verbatim: 2$	INC	AREA1		MUST BE IN TOP AREA1

claim: AREA2 is the MIDDLE-third empty flag SELARE increments (RAMDEF.SRC:303).

claim: Re-incarnation clears the AREA flags before the scan — CLR AREA1 begins the sweep (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5622).

source.verbatim: CLR	AREA1		FIND A CLEAR AREA TO APPEAR FROM

claim: The scan JSR SELARE classifies each active object into its third (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5634).

source.verbatim: 30$	JSR	SELARE		CHECK IF AREA IS CLEAR

claim: Select: LDA AREA3 tests whether the bottom area is empty before using its transporter (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5641).
Select: LDA AREA2 tests whether the middle area is empty (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5645).
Select: LDA AREA1 tests whether the top area is empty (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5651).
Player takes a number: LDA NPSERV draws the next player ticket (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5615).

source.verbatim: LDA	NPSERV		TAKE A NUMBER TO BE SERVED BY THE TRANSPORTER

claim: INC NPSERV advances the player take-a-number counter after the draw (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5617).
Player's turn test: CMPB LPSERV — served when the held number equals LPSERV (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5620).

source.verbatim: CREPLY	CMPB	LPSERV		IS IT THIS PLAYERS TURN?

claim: Enemy takes a number: LDA NESERV draws the next enemy ticket (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5664).

source.verbatim: LDA	NESERV		TAKE A NUMBER TO BE SERVED BY THE TRANSPORTER

claim: INC NESERV advances the enemy take-a-number counter after the draw (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5666).
Players first: LDA NPSERV reads whether any player still holds a number (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5672).

source.verbatim: LDA	NPSERV		ANY PLAYERS HOLDING A NUMBER?

claim: Players first: CMPA LPSERV compares the next player number against the one in service (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5673).
Players first: BNE CRELP — an unserved player makes enemies wait (find a transporter 1st) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5674).

source.verbatim: BNE	CRELP		 BR=YES, LET THEM FIND A TRANSPORTER 1ST

claim: Enemy's turn test: CMPB LESERV — served when the held number equals LESERV (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5675).

source.verbatim: CMPB	LESERV		IS IT THIS ENEMIES TURN?

claim: Serving a player bumps LPSERV to the next numbered card (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5722).

source.verbatim: INC	LPSERV	ALLOW PLAYERS NEXT NUMBERED CARD TO USE TRANSPORTER

claim: Serving an enemy bumps LESERV to the next numbered card (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5724).

source.verbatim: 2$	INC	LESERV	ALLOW ENEMIES NEXT NUMBERED CARD TO USE TRANSPORTER

claim: The materialisation window naps one frame per pass: PCNAP 1 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5828).
The window reads the whole joystick word: LDD CURJOY (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5831).
ANY nonzero joystick aborts early: BNE 51$ (player/enemy wants to flap) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5841).
An untouched window times out: BEQ 50$ when it elapses (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5848).
The abort handler 51$ is reached ABORTED EARLY on a control input (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5892).

source.verbatim: 51$	LDX	PDECSN,U	ABORTED EARLY, KILL SOUND

claim: PLYINT re-enables collisions on exit: LDA #$80 (enable this player’s collisions) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5923).
PLYINT ORs the enable bit into PID: ORA PID,U (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5924).
PLYINT stores the now-collidable PID: STA PID,U (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5925).

source.verbatim: CLR	PFACE,Y		PLAYER IS FACING RIGHT
